tasks.subject: Task 3: E16 row-run diff engine
tasks.description:
**Goal:** New src/shared/e16_diff.mjs decides how to describe the difference between two framebuffers as 0-N small regions or a full repaint, using row-run clustering rather than a single global bounding box.

**Files:**
- Create: src/shared/e16_diff.mjs
- Test: tests/host/test_e16_diff.sh

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] identical buffers -> {kind:"none"}
- [ ] prev===null -> {kind:"full"}
- [ ] single small change -> one rect region
- [ ] full-width single-row change -> one scanline region
- [ ] two far-apart changes (opposite corners) -> two SMALL regions, not one screen-sized box
- [ ] more than MAX_REGIONS runs -> full
- [ ] a region over FULL_REPAINT_THRESHOLD area -> full
- [ ] MAX_REGIONS/FULL_REPAINT_THRESHOLD overridable via opts
- [ ] tests/host/test_e16_diff.sh passes

**Verify:** bash tests/host/test_e16_diff.sh -> PASS

See docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-22-e16-partial-oled-updates.md Task 3 for full code.

tasks.subject: Task 4: Wire diff engine into createDisplay
tasks.description:
**Goal:** createDisplay()'s tick() sends SCANLINE/RECTANGLE for a small diff, drains a multi-region diff one message per tick, and still falls back to a full FRAMEBUFFER for a full diff, unknown prior state, or a mode switch -- with no behavior change for existing callers when the diff is full.

**Files:**
- Modify: src/shared/e16_surface.mjs:348-470 (createDisplay + its import line)
- Test: tests/host/test_e16_view.sh

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] single-region diff sends rect/scanline instead of framebuffer
- [ ] two-region diff drains across two tick() calls, first region first
- [ ] full diff / prev===null sends the whole framebuffer exactly as today
- [ ] switching want from framebuffer to labels (or back) drops any queued regions and forces a full repaint on return
- [ ] a refused send leaves lastSentBuf and the pending queue unchanged
- [ ] tick() return value includes "rect"/"scanline"
- [ ] all pre-existing test_e16_*.sh tests touching createDisplay still pass unmodified

**Verify:** for t in tests/host/test_e16_*.sh; do bash "$t" || echo "FAIL $t"; done -> no FAIL lines

See docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-22-e16-partial-oled-updates.md Task 4 for full code.

tasks.subject: Task 5: NACK invalidates diff baseline; docs
tasks.description:
**Goal:** An OLED UPDATE NACK invalidates lastSentBuf and drops queued regions so the next tick's diff falls back to a full repaint -- same recovery a replug already gets, no new timer or retry machinery. docs/E16_REMOTE.md documents the new opcodes.

**Files:**
- Modify: src/shared/e16_surface.mjs (createSysexAssembler dispatch in createSurface; new invalidateBuf() on createDisplay)
- Modify: docs/E16_REMOTE.md
- Test: tests/host/test_e16_wiring.sh

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] a NACK calls display.invalidateBuf(), nulling lastSentBuf and clearing pendingRegions/pendingBuf
- [ ] an ACK is a no-op
- [ ] NACK logging is rate-limited
- [ ] neither ACK nor NACK is confused with the unrelated REMOTE MODE ENTERED ACK
- [ ] docs/E16_REMOTE.md lists the 5 new opcodes, the header-byte ambiguity/decision, and the row-run diff strategy
- [ ] tests/host/test_e16_wiring.sh passes

**Verify:** bash tests/host/test_e16_wiring.sh -> PASS

See docs/superpowers/plans/2026-09-22-e16-partial-oled-updates.md Task 5 for full code.
